using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;
const int MAXN = 2000005;

long long parent[MAXN];
long long compSize[MAXN];

long long findParent(long long x) {
    long long r = x;
    while (parent[r] != r) r = parent[r];
    while (parent[x] != x) {
        long long p = parent[x];
        parent[x] = r;
        x = p;
    }
    return r;
}

void unite(long long a, long long b) {
    long long ra = findParent(a);
    long long rb = findParent(b);
    if (ra == rb) return;
    if (compSize[ra] < compSize[rb]) swap(ra, rb);
    parent[rb] = ra;
    compSize[ra] += compSize[rb];
}

long long modPow(long long base, long long exp) {
    base %= MOD;
    long long res = 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1LL) res = (res * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

    cin.tie(0);

    long long n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

        compSize[i] = 1;

    return 0;
